notes.title: Tavern Manager Simulator Biggest Update
notes.notes:
[p][b]This is our biggest update yet, celebrating the game's anniversary! We've added 4 new tavern levels and new mechanics![/b][/p][p][/p][h2]🎶Musicians and Concerts[/h2][p]What's a tavern without bards? Hire musicians and organize concerts in your tavern. Let your patrons dance!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/7df8a49461598fe399c80d6489d37f8edba02a8d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]👑Long Live the King! [/h2][p]The King himself may visit your tavern. Organize a grand feast for him, and perhaps he'll decide that your tavern is the best in the entire kingdom.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/9684524e0c65a3825f65e1d8b5df222174d57793.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🏺Artifact Display Cases and Magic Flowers[/h2][p]Put your artifacts on public display for all patrons to admire. And if you want to speed up your fairies, use the flowers they love so much.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/27bccf88237e9d2760b1ab5bda801572bd9daf88.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]Return to the tavern and build the Best Tavern Ever!

[/b][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2756770/Tavern_Manager_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][b]

[/b]🎉 Announcement: Anime Shop Simulator[/h2][p][b]If you want to support us, then add our next game to your Wishlist - a co-op anime shop simulator[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Manage your own anime shop . Play solo or team up with friends in 4-player co-op mode to grow your business. Stock shelves with manga, figures, and collectible cards in this immersive first-person game 🕹️

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3393280?utm_source=news_english/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]Join our discord and follow the news[/h2]
